description: Coordinate system mapping, transformation invariants, and camera presets for G1

authoringBlender.exportConversion: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y) performed exactly once during glTF export

singleConversionPolicy.rule: glTF files already embed the single Blender-to-glTF transform and authored F1 roots. The Three.js loader mounts all scenes strictly at identity (position [0,0,0], quaternion [0,0,0,1], scale [1,1,1]).
singleConversionPolicy.doubleOffsetGuard: NEVER apply [0.30, 0, -0.36] to the scene root or resident/chair parent. Roots resident, chair-root, and chair-base already possess authored translation [0.30, 0, -0.36] in their local TRS.
